resources.string:
Copy the game files you extracted from YOUR OWN legally-owned Xbox 360 copy of The Simpsons Game onto the phone (for example into Download/SimpsonsGame), then pick that folder below.

The folder must contain default.xex and the game's data files (about 4 GB).

On PC: run the desktop launcher, use its Install tab with your ISO, then copy the installed game folder to the phone.
Game data is not configured yet.

All-files access is required to read the folder in place. Grant it in the system settings screen that just opened, then come back and pick the folder again.
Storage permission is required to read the game folder. Grant it, then pick the folder again.
The picked folder does not contain default.xex. Make sure you copied the extracted game data (not the ISO itself).
Reset the saved game folder? You will need to pick it again.

Drag buttons to move them. Select a button and use +/− to resize it. Tap the eye to hide or show a button. All changes are saved automatically.
